verdict.rationale: Asking whether a crawling library keeps user data out of AI training is a fair privacy question, but the pack has no documented training opt-out, no-training policy, or data-use guarantee. Open-source availability, no forced API keys and self-hosted Docker deployment are adjacent properties, not a documented capability for this story, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
